subject: Proposed partner roundtable at PitchDeck Summit — joint session idea
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Subject: Proposed partner roundtable at PitchDeck Summit — joint session idea

Hi Tom & Priya,

Hope you’re both well — quick idea from our side: PitchDeck Summit (SF, Sept) is curating a partner track and we’d love to propose a co-branded roundtable — 45-min moderated discussion + 15-min live Q&A — focused on "Production-first inference: running LLMs reliably across hosted & private deployments."

High-level goals:
- Create a trusted GTM conversation for platform buyers (platform/infra + ISVs)
- Surface a short integration demo (how BlueAnchor + PitchDeck + Redwood can reduce time-to-value)
- Capture a short blog + social swap and a demo recording for nurture

Proposed logistics we can own from Redwood: moderator, 15-min integration demo, and a joint landing page. Would BlueAnchor and PitchDeck be interested in co-presenting? If yes, can we lock a 30-min sync next week to map speakers and draft blurb?

Attached: roundtable-outline.pdf (agenda / talking points) and draft-email-blurb.docx (initial copy for marketing).

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com

Ava — thanks for the invite, this sounds like a great fit for us. BlueAnchor would be happy to co-present. A few quick thoughts:
- We can bring a customer success story (short 8-min case study) and our solutions architect can demo the integration flows.
- Suggestion for moderator: Priya, would PitchDeck consider moderating? They know the audience and can steer vendor-neutral QA.
- Logistics: attendee cap is ~150 for partner roundtables — we should plan a focused invite list.

I’m around next Wed/Thu morning PT for a 30-min planning call.

Best,
